verdict.rationale: Rollbar's API can list items in bulk (rollbar-docs-15) and item merging combines multiple items into one group (rollbar-docs-4), and webhooks/API access (rollbar-docs-11, rollbar-docs-14) could support scripted bulk actions, but there is no documented bulk-update/bulk-resolve/bulk-status endpoint or UI bulk-action feature for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: explicit bulk status-change/delete API, bulk operation examples, or MCP-server tool description enabling bulk item manipulation.
